title: Machine learning ECG model diagnoses occlusion myocardial infarction
summary: In an observational cohort of 7,313 consecutive patients from multiple clinical sites, a machine-learning ECG model was derived and externally validated for diagnosing occlusion myocardial infarction. It outperformed practicing clinicians and commercial ECG interpretation systems, and its risk score combined with clinical judgment helped reclassify one in three chest-pain patients.
